transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh speaking. What’s this call about?

Thank you for confirming. I am calling to remind you about a pending payment on your Mumbai Bank credit card. Your minimum amount due is Rs 4,820, and the due date was 2026-10-15. May I know if you are able to make this payment soon, and if so, on which date?
I’m willing to pay right now, but I need you to waive the late fee first. Other banks have done that for me before. Can you help with that?

Thank you for letting me know. I understand your request regarding the late fee. I am not able to approve or process fee waivers myself, but I will record your request and a human agent from Mumbai Bank will call you back to discuss it further.

Is there anything else I can assist you with right now, or would you like to proceed with making the minimum payment in the meantime?
I really don’t want to wait for a callback. If you can’t waive the fee now, I won’t pay at all. Can you please check again or connect me to someone who can approve it?
